manifest.description: Your business on your site: details, opening hours, a map, contact details, a payment link, reviews and booking requests, and the structured data search engines read. Write opening hours like 09:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00 (empty means closed). Special days like: 2026-12-25 closed Christmas Day; 2026-12-2
manifest.author: oks-page

most.label: How many reviews to show (1 to 20, default 5)

service.label: Service (a name from your services; empty: the first)

columns.label: Secret address (put your site's address in front)

view.empty: The address appears after the first booking request, or within a few minutes.

type.label: Kind of business (Restaurant, Dentist, Hair salon, Shop...)

social.label: Your pages elsewhere (https:// addresses, separated by commas)

time_zone.label: Time zone of the business (for example Europe/Berlin)

special_days.label: Special days, separated by semicolons (see the description)

services.label: Services: name | minutes | price; next with a semicolon

booking_step.label: Booking times every ... minutes (5 to 120, default 30)

booking_notice_hours.label: Hours of notice needed (0 to 168, default 2)

booking_days.label: Days ahead that can be booked (1 to 60, default 14)

booking_instant.label: Confirm bookings at once, without asking me

booking_email.label: Tell me about bookings at (empty: the business email)
